title: 18Oct-Charter Meet RC Global Exchange &Connections
summary: On 18th October at 6:30 p.m., the Charter Meeting of the Rotary Club of Global Exchange and Connections, District 1820, hosted by Karen, brought Rotarians together through an international Zoom gathering.
description:
On 18th October at 6:30 p.m., the Charter Meeting of the Rotary Club of Global Exchange and Connections, District 1820, hosted by Karen, brought Rotarians together through an international Zoom gathering.

The dignified proceedings, inspiring presentations, fascinating anecdotes by founder member Jack from Illinois, and an engaging quiz made the event truly memorable. Rtn. Manoj Doshi’s inspiring address was a highlight. Rtn. PP Dr. Quresh Maskati scored 24/40, celebrating the learning experience about diverse cultures.

Rtn. PP Firoz Kachwalla conveyed warm wishes and proposed inviting the Charter Members to our Mumbai club meetings.

The key message: Youth are the future. Invest in youth to secure Rotary’s future!
Rotary’s Worldwide Historical Event – 18 Members, 16 Countries & 6 Continents!

Attended by 8 Members of our Club
